purpose: A compact count that can visually cap large values while preserving their full meaning.

component: Display max followed by + when count exceeds max; otherwise display count clamped at zero. title retains the original count.
When label is provided, hide the visual count and include the full raw count plus label in a visually hidden phrase. Without label, expose the displayed count directly.
host: Supply finite nonnegative whole counts, a finite nonnegative display cap and a contextual label for capped or ambiguous counts.
Own count calculation and updates. Use Indicator to position a count around another element.

Use data-display group tokens for owned presentation, preserve genuine nested component ownership, and verify the same geometry across Fundamental and Fundamental Floating in light/dark. Keep the documented semantics and state model when composing or extending this family.

limitations: CountBadge does not normalize invalid numbers/fractions or announce updates as a live region.
Negative display clamps to zero but its raw title/accessible phrase can still be negative; validate inputs at the host boundary.
Authored source coverage is separate from executed interaction, visual, accessibility and consumer-package evidence.
